purpose: Dry-run or separately execute the audit-compatible S-QSTN RulePack v1.1 on a held-out diagnostic using discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2.

conditions.description: An anonymized participant background plus the discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2 prompt card and the v1.1 context and audit layer.

sampling.unknown_status_policy: Unknown is not a dedicated stratum; it may appear only through the random_remaining slot. This diagnostic must not be treated as a final paper split.

labels: No, but ask me next time
Yes, but ask me next time

guardrails: The RulePack is static and directional only; no numerical weights, probabilities, confidence values, or state updates are active.
Human label_id and label_text remain outside every QSTN prompt and inference plan.
Unknown context fields are not inferred and are recorded in questionnaire_context_v1.1.csv and rule_context_audit.csv.
The default audit_compatible mode preserves the v1.0 permission-direction behavior.
Prompt burden is current-turn only; single-item presentation uses not_applicable_single_item.
Qualitative exploratory behavior is reserved for synthetic fixtures or prompt ablations and is not the default paper condition.
Ordinary respondent denial is not treated as an agent violation.
This diagnostic does not establish general human-likeness, causal RulePack benefit, or longitudinal fidelity.
A final paper comparison must use a separately frozen evaluation split and pre-registered conditions.
